response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings, AVG(p.per_day - o.avg_per_day) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.per_day > o.avg_per_day

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with a NULL rating value form their own group in GROUP BY; the verified data shows exactly 5 ratings, so this does not matter in practice. If no rating exceeds the average, both outputs are NULL (one row is still returned).
